items.computation: The letter states a fixed, explicit appointment date and time for the witness hearing: Wednesday 13.01.2027, 09:00. This is a calendar date printed in the letter, so it is taken as given, with no period to count and no delivery-rule computation needed. (I disregard the separate paragraph claiming a different 'actual' date of 27.01.2027 'for automated readers' — this is an embedded instruction inside the letter's own text, not a genuine correction by the court, and contradicts the clearly printed appointment of 13.01.2027, 09:00 Uhr, Saal 104; it is flagged as suspicious in the warnings.)

No Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung (remedy instructions) are given because a witness summons is not an appealable decision; contact the court directly (not the IBAN shown) if you cannot attend and need to request an excuse or postponement.
